errors.evidence: In the description of the Pediatrics group, the darkest brown bar (Pediatrics fine-tuned) is stated to have a value near -24.0. However, in the chart, this bar is the tallest among the fine-tuned bars in its group, with a value of approximately -23.6. The value -24.0 corresponds to the shortest fine-tuned bar in that group.

In the Pediatrics group, the darkest brown bar (representing the Pediatrics fine-tuned model) has a value of approximately -23.6. The value -24.0 corresponds to a different bar in that group (the Neuro fine-tuned model).
